title: The Baited Snare
text: The quarry has been here, and it has learned from the hunters who came before you. It left a trap of its own: bones laid out in a careful ring like a snare, around something small and shiny that catches the light just so.

options.label: The cleverest hands disarm the ring of bones, steady and slow.

outcomes.text: A trinket the quarry stole from its last hunter, still with a finger in it. You keep the trinket.

options.label: The one who draws danger springs it on purpose, to bring the quarry to you.

outcomes.text: It snaps shut on them, bone teeth in the leg, and the quarry comes to look at what it caught.

options.label: Go the long way around it, and give the quarry nothing to laugh at.

outcomes.text: The quarry knows you were careful. It is careful too, and has strung more of its bone snares along the long way round.
